DEC-001.question: Which store listings should the new app ship under, so existing users get it as an update?
DEC-001.note: A new listing on both: a fresh app in both stores; users of both old apps move to it, with a notice and a link in the old apps.

DEC-002.question: Minimum OS: what should the new app require?

DEC-003.question: Analytics: what happens to the 311 (Manager) and 185 (Employee) event names?
DEC-003.note: New event taxonomy: rename events for the new app; each rename is listed in a map, and dashboard owners remap.

DEC-004.question: Month view (CAP-001): which app's behavior does the new app keep?
DEC-004.note: Employee's, for both roles: one month view with me-ios's behavior. Employees see their own calendar; managers open a team member's calendar in the same view.

DEC-005.question: Scrolling list (CAP-002): which app's behavior does the new app keep?
DEC-005.note: Employee's: me-ios's list, both directions, jump to date, formatted durations.

DEC-006.question: Switching list/month (CAP-003): which app's behavior does the new app keep?
DEC-006.note: Employee's: one toolbar toggle, list view first, saved on the device.

DEC-007.question: Day details (CAP-004): which app's behavior does the new app keep?
DEC-007.note: Employee's: me-ios's richer sheet. For a manager viewing a team member, actions follow that manager's rights.

DEC-008.question: Customizing the calendar (CAP-005): which app's behavior does the new app keep?
DEC-008.note: Employee's: me-ios's filter set, including roster and hide weekends.

DEC-023.question: PLT-001 Bundle / application ids: keep it in the new app?
DEC-023.note: A new listing on both: the new app gets its own bundle and application ids (follows the store-listing answer).

DEC-024.question: PLT-002 Minimum OS: keep it in the new app?

DEC-025.question: PLT-006 Notification content extension (vmm): keep it in the new app?
DEC-025.note: Keep: users keep the rich push views (approval and anniversary pushes).

DEC-026.question: PLT-007 Notification service extension (vmm): keep it in the new app?
DEC-026.note: Keep: pushes keep their action buttons.

DEC-027.question: PLT-008 Share extension (me-ios): keep it in the new app?
DEC-027.note: Keep, and fix the lock: receipt sharing stays; the new extension requires the app lock.

DEC-028.question: PLT-033 App groups: keep it in the new app?
DEC-028.note: New groups only: the old ids are not carried over; the new app gets its own group for its extensions.

DEC-029.question: PLT-042 Local storage: keep it in the new app?
DEC-029.note: Start clean: users sign in again and data is re-fetched from the server; unsent drafts are lost unless sent first.

DEC-030.question: PLT-050 Firebase Cloud Messaging: keep it in the new app?
DEC-030.note: Keep: one push path for iOS and Android; the backends register the new app's tokens.

DEC-031.question: PLT-051 MMKV: keep it in the new app?
